edits.new: Include features needed to define the chosen sense or scope, including defining designs or methods. Distinguish required features from optional variations. Do not turn non-defining details about design, method or customary use into membership conditions.
edits.old: Include defining features needed to make the chosen sense or scope explicit; do not add design, method or customary-use details as further membership conditions. Distinguish defining features from optional variations.
Details that merely describe the post's example do not restrict the category.

edits.new: Preserve all explicitly named alternatives and parts.
edits.old: Preserve the subject's expressed restrictions and named identity, including all explicitly named alternatives and parts.

edits.new: Choose a supported interpretation for each ambiguity.
edits.old: When the selected subject admits competing senses or defining boundaries, choose a supported interpretation that preserves its identity, level of abstraction and expressed restrictions.
